pages.text: I can force one hostile creature into temporary service, but the bond feeds upon me.

$(bold)Mana:$() ½ bucket to bind$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Sustained after casting$(br2)Aim at a hostile within twelve blocks. It follows me and attacks uncontrolled hostiles. Once each second, I take one point of magic damage. Binding a new hostile replaces my previous controlled target; death or loss of either participant ends the bond.
